name: Azeroth Companion
title: Sovereign Portal — My Quick Deck, Orientation & Navigation
features: Added My Quick Deck to the redesigned homepage with up to six customizable shortcuts to any existing installed tool, stored only in an isolated website-preferences record.
Introduced a compact, optional five-step website orientation covering navigation, personal shortcuts, Blizzard account safety and manual backup practices.
Added a site-level page-context bar on studio pages with a clear Return Home action and automatic view-name updates.
Added a device-offline notice so visitors know when Blizzard lookups and release checks may need connectivity, without claiming the game or API is down.
Improved keyboard-accessible tour controls, discoverability, responsive quick-access cards, mobile safe-area treatment and reduced-motion handling.
Preserved every existing studio, Cloudflare Worker, Battle.net session, character database and stored progress record; made all v4.5 preferences separate from v4.4.
Retained the v4.4 cinematic homepage, appearance settings, grouped navigation and release center while adding a stronger personalized starting experience.
Expanded automated regression coverage for site isolation, accessibility, shortcut limits, mobile layouts and authenticated-data boundaries.
